video_title: ‘They will be a top-5 seed’ 👀 Kendrick Perkins on the Wizards’ hopes for next season | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis and Wizards table contract extension talks until regular season
quotes.excerpt: the Wizards and Anthony Davis have mutually decided to table potential contract extension talks
quotes.quote: Sources tell me that the Wizards and Anthony Davis have mutually decided to table potential contract extension talks and revisit it and wait until they are into the regular season for that and see where the team is at. One source described it to me as essentially an ability for both sides to allow the first 20 games or so to marinate and allow both sides to get to a decision on whether there will be a contract extension or not. Anthony Davis is eligible for a deal four years up to $275 million, but there are unanswered questions for both sides.

quotes.speaker: King McClure
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa's versatility and potential impact on the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: the word that I use when I talk about AJ is versatility
quotes.quote: There is no secret that he didn't shoot the three well, but the word that I use when I talk about AJ is versatility. And I think that was on full display and I think that's a big reason why he can contribute and make this Wizards team a potential playoff contender. He can get through to the rim. He can finish through traffic. It doesn't matter. The athleticism right there. And in the open floor, he passes my man open. Look at the vision. He always has his head up and I think that's one of the most underrated facets of his game is his passing.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins ranks the Wizards as a top-five Eastern Conference team
quotes.excerpt: I'm a crank it off. Coming in at number five. Bam, put it up there, damn it.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Vinnie, this is your first time. I don't want no stuff out of you. You are going to bring the energy that's needed, otherwise you will not be invited back. But I'm a crank it off. Coming in at number five. Bam, put it up there, damn it.

text_blocks.speaker: Vanessa Richardson
text_blocks.text: Woah, the Washington Wizards. The Washington Wizards.

text_blocks.speaker: Vanessa Richardson
text_blocks.text: All you got to do is say bam, Vinnie.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Bam. Number four. Are you high, Vinnie? Say bam. There it go.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts the Wizards will make the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I double down on the outfit, so I'm a double down on my take with the Wizards.
quotes.quote: I double down on the outfit, so I'm a double down on my take with the Wizards. They are going to make the playoffs. And guess what? I have even more confidence now that Anthony Davis is going to wait and he is going to audition and bet on himself. That's going to be scary. And I'm glad King gave us that beautiful breakdown and showed us what AJ Dybantsa could do defensively. Because when you think about their front court depth, Sarr, Anthony Davis, the Dybantsa, the size, the athleticism, the will to want to play defense, it's going to be scary.

quotes.speaker: Zach Lowe
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Lowe argues for prioritizing AJ Dybantsa's development
quotes.excerpt: they have the number one overall pick and I think prioritizing his development should be number one.
quotes.quote: They have the number one overall pick and I think prioritizing his development should be number one. A little like the Kings conversation we had yesterday where everything is really about A-Cuff. Sure, Sabonis matters, Lavine, all that. I see that here where I do think there's a lot of motivations for a lot of people, job security wise, but generally what AJ Dybantsa looks like in 2029-2030, that needs to be the priority. I don't necessarily think they have to make the playoffs, but I do think like Perk is saying, it's in the conversation.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on AJ Dybantsa's desire to be the number one pick
quotes.excerpt: AJ Dybantsa emphasized time and time again that he wanted to be the number one pick.
quotes.quote: Let me remind y'all, in a deep draft full of talent, AJ Dybantsa emphasized time and time again that he wanted to be the number one pick, that he deserved to be the number one pick over Darian Peterson, Darius A-Cuff, and the rest of the top 10. So with that being said, you know how you separate yourself? You separate yourself by going in there and putting your fingerprints on the league right now. You separate yourself and going in year one with the talent and the best that you have around you and saying, I'm about to bring chocolate back to Chocolate City.
